title: Generative Modeling for Cascading Extremes via Autoregressive Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2611.05728v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Extreme events often occur sequentially, from earthquake-tsunami cascades to successive extreme losses in financial markets. We introduce an extremal token representation that encodes multivariate observations as a categorical sequence. A quiet token records the absence of threshold exceedances; otherwise, the token identifies the exceeding component with the largest marginal probability-scale score. The representation is invariant to componentwise strictly increasing transformations. It preserves the identity and temporal ordering of dominant exceedances but discards their magnitudes and the identities of nondominant simultaneous exceedances. A decoder-only transformer estimates the history-dependent next-token kernel on this representation, and recursive sampling generates future token sequences from the induced joint predictive law. We amortize our generative model by pretraining across simulated process families with varying parame

translated_title: 通过自回归Transformer实现级联极端事件的生成式建模
translated_abstract: 极端事件往往接连发生，从地震-海啸级联到金融市场中接连出现的极端损失。我们提出了一种极值标记表示方法，将多变量观测编码为分类序列。其中一个“安静”标记用于记录不存在超过阈值的情况；否则，该标记以最大的边际概率尺度得分来识别发生超限的分量。这种表示方法对逐分量的严格单调递增变换保持不变。它保留了主导超限事件的身份信息和时间顺序，但丢弃了其量级大小以及同时发生的非主导超限事件的身份信息。我们使用仅解码器的Transformer在该表示上估计依赖历史信息的下一标记核函数，并通过递归采样从诱导出的联合预测规律中生成未来的标记序列。我们通过在具有不同参数的模拟过程族上进行预训练，来摊销这一生成式模型的计算成本。
tldr: 该论文提出一种将多变量极端事件观测编码为分类标记序列的极值表示方法，并利用预训练的仅解码器自回归Transformer学习历史依赖的标记转移规律，从而实现对级联极端事件未来演化的生成式建模与预测。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces an extremal token representation that encodes multivariate observations as invariant categorical sequences, and employs a decoder-only autoregressive transformer pretrained across simulated process families to generate and predict cascading extreme events through recursive sampling.
